d.a: Distribution and ecology: — Telipogon yanesha is only known from the montane forests of Yanachaga Chemillén National Park in the Oxapampa – Asháninka – Yánesha Biosphere Reserve, between 2100 – 2300 m of elevation (Figure 1); the species grows on the highest twigs (16 – 18 m) of Miconia calophylla Crueger (1847: 109) canopy. The new species has been reported flowering in March, one of the months with the highest rainfall of the year where a population of approximately seven individuals were counted between adults and juveniles.
